hyperscaler_platform_bar.statement: Oyatie Cloud is treated as a hyperscaler-grade cloud platform. Every microservice runs as a tenant workload on it (dogfooding per ADR-0242). Every decision, new or existing, must meet hyperscaler scalability, performance, and optimization requirements before any maturity claim.
scalability_requirements: Independent horizontal scaling per microservice; stateless request paths; shardable state (ADR-0348 autosharding + auto-rebalance + dynamic sharding).
Cellular architecture as a pattern with cell-rebalancer + cell-lifecycle microservices (ADR-0248, ADR-0341, ADR-0351); no single-cell global bottleneck.
Multi-region, multi-cell tenant routing with per-tenant isolation (ADR-0244, ADR-0254 deployment-model spectrum).
performance_requirements: Each microservice manifest declares explicit latency/throughput SLO targets and a capacity model (ADR-0340); claims are blocked until measured evidence is green.
Async-first eventing on Apache Pulsar (launch-primary) with Kafka/Redpanda/RabbitMQ adapters; backpressure and brown-out degradation signals are first-class.
Approved runtime stack tuned for throughput: Tokio + Axum/Tower/tower-http + Hyper/hyper-util; observability via tracing + OpenTelemetry SDK.
optimization_requirements: FinOps dimensional cost model + OpenCost/FOCUS export (ADR-0344); per-tenant cost attribution.
Pod runtime tiering runc/Kata/Cloud-Hypervisor by trust tier (ADR-0338) for density vs isolation optimization.
Progressive delivery (progressive-delivery controller or Oya-native equivalent) and SLO-gated promotion; no promotion past dev without SLO authoring.
hyperscaler_platform_bar.parallel_execution_mandate: Consolidation and greening run as disjoint parallel workstreams (WS-1 enterprise, WS-2 workflow, WS-3 intelligence, WS-4 backbone) under a single-writer invariant on shared files; isolated git worktrees give separate build dirs for true concurrency, fanned in via the Foundry merge queue (ADR-0111).

gitops_vcs_replacement.summary: Oyatie Native SCM preserves grit-style AST/semantic locks and isolated work, then adds provider-neutral ChangeSets, native/provider-backed semantic merge queues, virtual merge stacks, queue-aware locks, review/CI/security/release-conveyor fix loops, dev→staging→production release trains, and Rust compile-latency scheduling. GitHub publication adapter, GitHub Actions shadow evidence, scanner evidence, and native release-conveyor adapters are first-class adapters, not core dependencies; native/in-house adapters must provide the same features. It also handles variable-speed agent bursts and many PR views/hour by scheduling ChangeSets rather than provider PRs, applying PR apertures/backpressure/batching, and linking every ChangeSet to provider-neutral OyaWorkItems through a GitHub Issues adapter or native issue tracker.

Swift/Kotlin/C#/C++/XAML/TypeScript/config/contract semantic indexers with cross-language dependency edges.
Typed review/fix loop plus controller-owned rebase and merge queue orchestration, with CI/CD evidence and terminal states.
Document and machine-encode unit/integration/e2e standards, registry-driven commands, and CI/CD admission enforcement.
Language-neutral AST symbol/range/dependency contract used by claims, review mapping, impacted tests, and semantic conflict checks.

ideal_production_roadmap._doc: Ideal long-term 0->100 production roadmap for the Oyatie Cloud hyperscaler platform + tenant microservices. Authority: this section + ADR-0358/ADR-0516. Strangler-fig migration; Buck2 build/test/check authority + oya governance overlay; production-100 bar defined collaboratively in P-DEFINE. Research-grounded (Google TAP affected-targets, Amazon Apollo staged rollout, Microsoft rings, Oracle blue-green, Nygard ADR immutability). Honest: this is a roadmap-spec; no production/hyperscaler-maturity claim until P-DEFINE bar evidence is green.
ideal_production_roadmap.posture: Layered migration: the cloud-* SUBSTRATE (production-100 product) is built GREENFIELD (new IaaS/PaaS, per plan/hyperscaler-grade-cloud-platform-greenfield-plan.md phases P0-P10); EXISTING product microservices (FD-001 enterprise/workflow/backbone) are STRANGLER-FIG migrated onto the proven substrate behind contracts (ADR-0358). Trunk always shippable; parallel lanes; cut over only when green.

phases.title: Define production-100 exit bar
phases.deliverable: Collaboratively define: scale targets, compliance packs, deployment model (ADR-0254), first production workload (FD-001 candidate), SLO/DR/security/cost exit gates. No production claim until green.

production_100_bar._status: RATIFIED 2026-05-25 (dimension-by-dimension with user). 100 = the Oyatie Cloud hyperscaler substrate operated as a real multi-region IaaS/PaaS. Ambitious multi-year target; the roadmap phases sequence the path. All maturity claims blocked_until_required_evidence_is_green.
production_100_bar.first_production_product: The cloud-* substrate itself, operated as IaaS/PaaS for tenants (NOT a tenant product). cloud-* services graduate from today's metadata-only foundations to LIVE provisioning via the Cloud Control Plane (ORN -> Resource Registry -> Operation Ledger -> API Gateway -> Workflow/Reconciler -> OpenTofu/operators/native reconcilers). Tenant product microservices (FD-001) are post-100, served on the proven substrate (ADR-0242 dogfooding).
production_100_bar.substrate_cut: FULL cloud-* set live: Cloud Control Plane + IAM + KMS + Secrets + Compute + Storage + Network + Data + Billing + Capacity. Each: provision -> operate -> meter -> audit -> rollback.
production_100_bar.deployment_models: shared-cloud multi-tenant + dedicated-cloud single-tenant (both oyatie-operated, ADR-0254). hybrid-BYO / on-prem-connected / air-gapped are post-100.
production_100_bar.scale_bar: Multi-region hyperscale: many tenants, >=3 active regions, high sustained+burst rps; autosharding + auto-rebalance + dynamic sharding proven (ADR-0348); cellular architecture with no single-cell global bottleneck (ADR-0248/0341).
production_100_bar.compliance_gate: KR + JP + US + EU all gate 100 (four major markets): KR (Labor Standards/4대보험/HomeTax/K-GAAP/PIPA/ISMS-P); JP (APPI/My Number/J-SOX/electronic-bookkeeping); US (SOC2/SOX/CCPA + HIPAA-design where health data); EU (GDPR/NIS2). Cross-border transfer constraints + per-pack data-residency enforced. Other packs (SG/AU/IN/BR/AE/KSA) post-100.
production_100_bar.slo_exit: Measured >=99.9% availability per cloud-* service across regions; per-microservice manifest SLO/latency targets green (ADR-0340); burn-rate alerting + agentic SLO-gated promotion; control-plane operation-ledger durability for every create/update/delete.
production_100_bar.dr_exit: Multi-region DR with RTO/RPO matrix per service + per-compliance-pack (ADR-0343); >=1 executed cross-region failover drill per region pair (evidence, not claim).
production_100_bar.security_exit: Cedar default-deny universal gate (ADR-0243); tenant isolation proven for BOTH shared (logical: cell+Cedar+per-tenant-encryption) and dedicated (physical cell pinning); cosign-signed images verified at admission via Kubewarden (ADR-0181); 0 critical/high CVE (trivy); no raw secret/PII in logs; audit-chain emission live (ADR-0263).
production_100_bar.cost_exit: FinOps per-tenant cost attribution + OpenCost/FOCUS export live (ADR-0344); mandatory quota/metering/billing resource contract per resource type.
production_100_bar.ci_cd_exit: cloud-ci/oya-ci required context plus Buck2 build/test/lint graph evidence; native release conveyor progressive delivery (canary -> bake -> automatic metric-gated rollback) proven on cloud-* deploys; merge-queue speculative+batch (ADR-0111); local governance evidence is bridge-only and not exit authority.
production_100_bar.master_exit_rule: 100 = the full cloud-* substrate LIVE across shared+dedicated deployment, multi-region hyperscale, KR-compliant, with ALL exit gates GREEN on measured evidence. Until then every production/hyperscaler-maturity claim stays blocked_until_required_evidence_is_green (hyperscaler-gates.json).
quality_evidence_kits: overload/fairness/load-shedding (request-cost classes, retry budgets, queue limits) — AWS load-shedding
shuffle-sharded tenant isolation (assignment policy + correlated-blast-radius + noisy-neighbor drills) — AWS shuffle sharding
privacy/data-governance (personal-data inventory, residency, retention, deletion, export, redaction) — NIST Privacy Framework; KR/JP/US/EU packs
automated canary + Production-Readiness-Review (one-cell canary, automated eval, rollback triggers) — Google SRE
FOCUS-compatible cost-and-usage export (allocation dims, invoice reconciliation) — FOCUS 1.3+
Kubernetes Pod Security Standards admission gate (restricted/baseline; privileged needs owner/expiry/mitigation)
abuse/fraud/DDoS readiness (signup/payment risk, suspension workflow, ingress protection, customer-safe comms)
production_100_bar.maturity_ladder: L0 prototype -> L1..L6 -> L7 global hyperscaler; each level preserves prior-level evidence; breadth expansion forbidden without preserved evidence; 100 target sits at the defined ladder level with all gates green on measured evidence (no marketing claim before evidence).
production_100_bar.definition_of_done: Every changeset: respects path-envelope; produces acceptance-criteria evidence; ships narrowest verification command; declares public-contract/telemetry/security/rollback impact; is consumable by dependents; source-version hygiene clean. Phase checkpoint promotes only when all changesets satisfy DoD or are explicitly deferred.
evidence_packs_preview_to_ga: reliability pack (SLO history, incident readiness, scale tests)
